desc:
CHEX MIX: Snack Mix loaded with fun, flavorful shapes of Chex, pretzels, rye chips, and breadsticks

SAVORY SNACK MIX: With Corn Chex, Wheat Chex, pretzels, rye chips, and mini breadsticks lightly seasoned in a honey barbecue flavor, you’ll get crunchy and delicious all in one

PARTY FAVORITE: Endless taste and texture combinations make it the perfect party mix snack for get-togethers of all shapes and sizes; Not your standard pub mix, trail mix, or bar snack

EASY AND PORTABLE: Stock your pantry with this delicious snack to share with friends and family

CONTAINS: One 8 oz bag of Chex Mix Honey BBQ Snack Mix
features:
Features

Balanced Sweet & Savory Flavor

Combines honey sweetness with salty crunch in every bite.

Mixed Textures

A satisfying blend of crunchy cereals, pretzels, and sweet cookie pieces.

Lower-Fat Snack Option

Contains significantly less fat than traditional chip snacks.

Convenient, Ready-to-Eat

Portable bag format—ideal for travel, lunchboxes, and gatherings.

Benefits

Dual Flavor Satisfaction

Blends sweet and salty cravings without being overly heavy.

Perfect for Sharing and Snacking

Great for family movie nights, on-the-go breaks, or group settings.

Kid-Friendly

Includes fun cookie bits that appeal to children alongside the savory mix.

Quick Energy Boost

Carbohydrate-rich for a fast pick-me-up between meals.
ingredients: Whole Wheat, Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Enriched Flour (wheat flour, niacin, iron, riboflavin, thiamin mononitrate, folic acid), Vegetable Oil (soybean, high oleic soybean, high oleic canola, high oleic sunflower, palm, fractionated palm, palm olein and/or sunflower), Sugar, Rye Flour. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Fructose, Spices, Celery Powder, Yeast, Dried Molasses, Brown Sugar, Tomato Powder, Dried Garlic, Paprika (color), Baking Soda, Maltodextrin, Dried Honey, Dried Onion, Distilled Monoglycerides, Yeast Extract, Malted Barley Extract, Barley Malt Syrup, Dried Prepared Mustard (dried vinegar, mustard seed, salt, turmeric), Wheat Starch, Yellow Corn Flour, Trisodium Phosphate, Calcium Carbonate, Citric Acid, Rye Flour, Fumaric Acid, Caraway, Natural Flavor, Sodium Diacetate, Dried Soy Sauce (soybeans, wheat, salt), Caramel Color. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
